ipxact:addressBlock.ipxact:name: entropy_source
ipxact:addressBlock.ipxact:description: Entropy-source configuration, status, and data registers.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: COMPONENT_ID
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Identifies the entropy-source register interface.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: NAME
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Entropy-source component identifier.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: MINOR_VERSION
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Minor interface version.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: MAJOR_VERSION
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Major interface version.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: CTRL
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Controls entropy generation and conditioning.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: RSVD0
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Reserved; reads zero and ignores writes.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: MODULE_ENABLE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Enables startup health testing and entropy output. Clearing this field holds the main state machine idle. FIPS_LOCK.LOCK prevents software changes.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: AUTOTUNE_ENABLE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Enables per-generator automatic detuning after a lane health-test failure. FIPS_LOCK.LOCK prevents software changes.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: BYPASS_ENTROPY_COMPRESSOR
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Bypasses BIW extraction and writes the twelve generator bytes to the FIFO as three 32-bit words. FIPS_LOCK.LOCK prevents software changes.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: DOWNSAMPLE_RATE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Selects every (N+1)th decorrelator output while BIW extraction is bypassed. FIPS_LOCK.LOCK prevents software changes.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: SHA256_WHITENING_ENABLE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Enables SHA-256 conditioning of each 512-bit BIW input block into a 256-bit digest. When clear, BIW words pass directly to the FIFO. FIPS_LOCK.LOCK prevents software changes.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: DEBUG_CTRL
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Controls the external debug observation pin. FIPS_LOCK.LOCK prevents software changes to the signal selection and divider.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: SELECT_SIGNAL
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Selects the observed signal: generator noise bits [11:0], sample clocks [27:16], BIW data [63:32], FIFO input [95:64], or generator bytes [223:128]. Other selections drive the divider input low. FIPS_LOCK.LOCK prevents software changes.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: SELECT_FREQ_DIV
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Selects observation division by 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64, or 128. FIPS_LOCK.LOCK prevents software changes.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: INTR_STATUS
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Reports latched interrupt status; write one to clear a bit.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: HEALTH_TEST_FAILED
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Indicates a failure in the 32-bit entropy-stream health tests. Write one to clear.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: FIFO_ERROR
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Indicates a FIFO integrity error. Write one to clear.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: FIFO_OVERFLOW
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Indicates that a main FIFO write was discarded while full. Write one to clear.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: FIFO_UNDERFLOW
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Indicates that software read the empty main FIFO. Write one to clear.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: PERSISTENT_FAILURE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Indicates a persistent health-test failure or health-test counter error. Write one to clear.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: AUTOTUNE_FAIL
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Indicates a per-generator health-test failure while automatic detuning is enabled. Write one to clear.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: BIW_OBS_OVERFLOW
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Indicates that a BIW observe FIFO word was discarded while full. Write one to clear.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: NOISE_OBS_OVERFLOW
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Indicates that a raw-noise observe FIFO word was discarded while full. Write one to clear.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: INTR_ENABLE
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Enables individual interrupt sources.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: HEALTH_TEST_FAILED
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Enables the health-test failure interrupt.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: FIFO_ERROR
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Enables the FIFO integrity-error interrupt.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: FIFO_OVERFLOW
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Enables the main FIFO overflow interrupt.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: FIFO_UNDERFLOW
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Enables the main FIFO underflow interrupt.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: PERSISTENT_FAILURE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Enables the persistent-failure interrupt.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: AUTOTUNE_FAIL
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Enables the automatic-detuning failure interrupt.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: BIW_OBS_OVERFLOW
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Enables the BIW observe FIFO overflow interrupt.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: NOISE_OBS_OVERFLOW
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Enables the raw-noise observe FIFO overflow interrupt.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: INTR_TEST
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Triggers individual interrupt sources for testing.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: HEALTH_TEST_FAILED
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Write one to pulse the health-test failure interrupt source.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: FIFO_ERROR
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Write one to pulse the FIFO integrity-error interrupt source.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: FIFO_OVERFLOW
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Write one to pulse the main FIFO overflow interrupt source.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: FIFO_UNDERFLOW
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Write one to pulse the main FIFO underflow interrupt source.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: PERSISTENT_FAILURE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Write one to pulse the persistent-failure interrupt source.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: AUTOTUNE_FAIL
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Write one to pulse the automatic-detuning failure interrupt source.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: BIW_OBS_OVERFLOW
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Write one to pulse the BIW observe FIFO overflow interrupt source.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: NOISE_OBS_OVERFLOW
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Write one to pulse the raw-noise observe FIFO overflow interrupt source.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: SHA256_STATUS
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Reports SHA-256 conditioner progress.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: BUSY
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Indicates that SHA-256 processing or digest output is active.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: INPUT_COUNT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Number of 32-bit words currently accumulated in the 512-bit input block.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: OUTPUT_COUNT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Number of 32-bit digest words remaining for output. Reports 8 when a digest becomes available, decrements through 0 as words are accepted, and remains 0 while idle or bypassed.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: FIFO_CTRL
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Controls the 64-entry main entropy FIFO.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: ENABLE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Enables FIFO writes. Reads remain available while writes are disabled. Words offered to the FIFO are also the DRBG seed stream, which this field does not gate. FIPS_LOCK.LOCK prevents software changes.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: ENTROPY_CHURN_ENABLE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: XORs each incoming word with the FIFO entry 32 positions ahead of the write pointer. FIPS_LOCK.LOCK prevents software changes.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: FIFO_STATUS
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Reports main FIFO occupancy and pointers.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: LEVEL
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Number of valid 32-bit words in the FIFO.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: WPTR
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Current FIFO write pointer.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: RPTR
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Current FIFO read pointer.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: FIFO_RDATA
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Provides the next main FIFO word.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: RDATA
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Returns and removes the next FIFO word. Reading an empty FIFO sets INTR_STATUS.FIFO_UNDERFLOW and returns undefined data.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: HEALTH_TEST_CTRL
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Controls continuous entropy health tests.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: ENABLE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Enables the repetition-count, adaptive-proportion, and Markov tests in bits 0, 1, and 2. Disabling a test clears its state.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: REPETITION_LIMIT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Maximum allowed per-lane repetition count before the test fails. FIPS_LOCK.LOCK prevents software changes.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: HEALTH_TEST_WINDOW_SIZE
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Sets the APT and Markov window length.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: SIZE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Number of valid entropy words per APT and Markov window. FIPS_LOCK.LOCK requires a value of at least 1024 and prevents software changes.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: MARKOV_TEST_PROB_THRESHOLDS
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Sets high and low Markov alternation-count thresholds.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: PROB_01_THRESHOLD
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Maximum allowed per-lane alternation count at the window boundary. FIPS_LOCK.LOCK prevents software changes.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: PROB_10_THRESHOLD
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Minimum allowed per-lane alternation count at the window boundary. FIPS_LOCK.LOCK prevents software changes.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: HEALTH_TEST_STATUS
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Latches 32-bit stream health-test failures: repetition [0], APT high or low [3], Markov high [4], and Markov low [5]. Write one to clear.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: HEALTH_STATUS
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Latched health-test failure bits; write one to clear.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: REPETITION_TEST_COUNT
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Reports the highest current repetition count.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: REPETITION_COUNT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Highest current repetition count among the 32 entropy lanes.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: APT_PATTERN_COUNT_1BIT
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Reports the highest per-lane APT one-count in the current window.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: PATTERN_COUNT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Highest current one-count among the 32 entropy lanes.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: APT_PATTERN_COUNT_2BIT
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Reports the lowest per-lane APT one-count in the current window.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: PATTERN_COUNT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Lowest current one-count among the 32 entropy lanes.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: APT_PROPORTION_1BIT
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Sets the APT high one-count threshold.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: LIMIT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Maximum allowed per-lane one-count at the window boundary. FIPS_LOCK.LOCK prevents software changes.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: APT_PROPORTION_LO
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Sets the APT low one-count threshold.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: LIMIT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Minimum allowed per-lane one-count at the window boundary. Zero disables the low-side test. FIPS_LOCK.LOCK prevents software changes.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: MARKOV_TEST_COUNTS_0
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Reports the highest and lowest per-lane alternation counts in the current Markov window.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: COUNT_01
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Highest current per-lane alternation count.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: COUNT_10
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Lowest current per-lane alternation count.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: RING_OSC_ENABLE
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Controls noise and sample-clock ring oscillators.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: ENABLE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Enables each generator noise ring oscillator. FIPS_LOCK.LOCK prevents software changes.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: SAMPLE_CLK_ENABLE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Enables the shared sample-clock ring oscillator when any bit is set. FIPS_LOCK.LOCK prevents software changes.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: RING_OSC_TUNE
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Selects detuned ring-oscillator tap points.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: DETUNE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Selects the full-length (longer) tap for each noise ring oscillator, lowering its frequency, while automatic tuning is disabled; the reset value (clear) selects the shorter tap. FIPS_LOCK.LOCK prevents software changes.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: SAMPLE_CLK_DETUNE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Selects the full-length (longer) shared sample-clock oscillator tap, lowering its frequency, when any bit is set. FIPS_LOCK.LOCK prevents software changes.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: RING_OSC_CTRL
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Selects each generator sample-clock source.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: SAMPLE_CLK_SELECT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Selects the shared internal sample clock when set and the external sample clock when clear. FIPS_LOCK.LOCK prevents software changes.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: DECORRELATOR_CTRL
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Controls generator decorrelation and byte cadence.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: BYPASS
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Bypasses the LFSR feedback path independently for each generator. FIPS_LOCK.LOCK prevents software changes.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: SAMPLE_CLK_DIV
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Sets the generator byte-output period to this value plus one sample-clock cycles. FIPS_LOCK.LOCK prevents software changes.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: DECORRELATOR_MASK
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Masks bits in every generator entropy byte.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: ENTROPY_BYTE_MASK
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Enables corresponding entropy-byte bits when set. FIPS_LOCK.LOCK prevents software changes.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: MAIN_SM_STATUS
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Reports the startup health-test gate state machine.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: STATE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Current sparse-encoded state-machine state.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: IDLE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Indicates that the state machine is idle.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: ALERT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Latches entry into the persistent-failure alert path, which halts entropy output. Write one or reset the block to clear.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: ERR
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Latches an illegal state or health-test counter integrity error. Write one or reset the block to clear.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: BOOT_PHASE_DONE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Indicates successful completion of startup health testing and permits entropy output.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: ALERT_CNTR_CLR_OK
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Indicates that a passing window may clear alert failure counters.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: GENERATOR_0_HEALTH_STATUS
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Latches generator 0 health-test failures; write one to clear.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: STATUS
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Generator 0 failure bits use the HEALTH_TEST_STATUS allocation.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: GENERATOR_1_HEALTH_STATUS

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: STATUS
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Generator 1 failure bits use the HEALTH_TEST_STATUS allocation.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: STATUS
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Generator 4 failure bits use the HEALTH_TEST_STATUS allocation.

ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Generator 5 failure bits use the HEALTH_TEST_STATUS allocation.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: STATUS
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Generator 11 failure bits use the HEALTH_TEST_STATUS allocation.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: GENERATOR_0_SAMPLE_CLK_CONFIG
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Controls generator 0 sample-clock division.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: SAMPLE_CLK_DIVIDE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Selects division by 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, or 32. FIPS_LOCK.LOCK prevents software changes.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: HT_WATERMARK_NUM
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Selects the counter and direction for the shared health-test watermark. Changing the selection preserves the current watermark.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: WATERMARK_NUM
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Selects the watermark source. Unsupported values select REPCNT_HI.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: HT_WATERMARK
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Reports one selector-dependent watermark. A CTRL.MODULE_ENABLE rising edge arms high modes to zero and low modes to 0xFFFF.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: WATERMARK_VALUE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Current shared watermark value.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: REPCNT_TOTAL_FAILS
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Counts repetition-test failures since the last CTRL.MODULE_ENABLE rising edge.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: FAIL_COUNT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Total repetition-test failure pulses.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: APT_HI_TOTAL_FAILS
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Counts APT high-threshold failures since the last CTRL.MODULE_ENABLE rising edge.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: FAIL_COUNT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Total APT high-threshold failure pulses.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: APT_LO_TOTAL_FAILS
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Counts APT low-threshold failures since the last CTRL.MODULE_ENABLE rising edge.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: FAIL_COUNT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Total APT low-threshold failure pulses.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: MARKOV_HI_TOTAL_FAILS

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: FAIL_COUNT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Total Markov high-threshold failure pulses.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: MARKOV_LO_TOTAL_FAILS
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Counts Markov low-threshold failures since the last CTRL.MODULE_ENABLE rising edge.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: FAIL_COUNT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Total Markov low-threshold failure pulses.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: ALERT_SUMMARY_FAIL_COUNTS
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Counts consecutive health-test windows containing any failure and clears after an accepted passing window.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: ANY_FAIL_COUNT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Number of consecutive failing health-test windows.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: ALERT_FAIL_COUNTS
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Reports saturating per-test failure counts for the current alert sequence.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: APT_LO_FAIL_COUNT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Saturating APT low-threshold failure count.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: APT_HI_FAIL_COUNT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Saturating APT high-threshold failure count.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: MARKOV_LO_FAIL_COUNT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Saturating Markov low-threshold failure count.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: MARKOV_HI_FAIL_COUNT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Saturating Markov high-threshold failure count.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: REPCNT_FAIL_COUNT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Saturating repetition-test failure count.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: FIPS_LOCK
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Locks entropy generation, conditioning, and health-test configuration against software writes until hardware reset.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: LOCK
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Write one to set the configuration lock. Only hardware reset clears it.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: ALERT_THRESHOLD
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Sets the failing-window count that enters the persistent-failure alert path.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: THRESHOLD
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Number of consecutive failing windows that triggers the alert; zero disables this trigger. FIPS_LOCK.LOCK prevents software changes.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: MIN_ENTROPY_H
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Stores assessed per-sample min-entropy in unsigned Q4.4 format for advisory threshold calculation.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: H
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Assessed min-entropy in bits per sample. FIPS_LOCK.LOCK prevents software changes.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: RECOMMENDED_THRESHOLDS
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Reports advisory repetition and APT thresholds derived from MIN_ENTROPY_H.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: RCT_LIMIT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Advisory repetition-count cutoff C = 1 + ceil(20 / H).

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: APT_LIMIT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Advisory APT high cutoff derived for a 1024-sample window.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: BIW_OBS_CTRL
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Controls copy-only capture of the post-BIW, pre-SHA stream.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: RAW_ENABLE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Enables capture after startup health testing completes. FIPS_LOCK.LOCK prevents software changes.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: BIW_OBS_STATUS
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Reports BIW observe FIFO occupancy and pointers.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: LEVEL
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Number of valid 32-bit words in the BIW observe FIFO.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: WPTR
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Current BIW observe FIFO write pointer.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: RPTR
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Current BIW observe FIFO read pointer.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: BIW_OBS_RDATA
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Provides the next post-BIW, pre-SHA observe word.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: RDATA
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Returns and removes the next BIW observe FIFO word.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: NOISE_OBS_CTRL
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Controls copy-only capture of one pre-decorrelator generator lane.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: RAW_ENABLE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Enables LSB-first packing of selected-lane samples into 32-bit observe words. FIPS_LOCK.LOCK prevents software changes.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: FLUSH
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Write one to discard buffered raw-noise words. Changing LANE_SEL also flushes the FIFO.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: LANE_SEL
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Selects generator lane 0 through 11; other values select lane 0. Changing lanes restarts packing and flushes buffered words.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: NOISE_OBS_STATUS
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Reports raw-noise observe FIFO occupancy and pointers.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: LEVEL
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Number of valid 32-bit words in the raw-noise observe FIFO.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: WPTR
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Current raw-noise observe FIFO write pointer.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: RPTR
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Current raw-noise observe FIFO read pointer.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: NOISE_OBS_RDATA
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Provides the next packed raw-noise observe word.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: RDATA
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Returns and removes 32 LSB-first pre-decorrelator samples from the selected lane.
